display_name: Which card earns the most on this purchase — twelve Singapore card programmes, encoded module by issuer document from 28 documents held by link
versions_encoded: Each document as retrieved 2026-10-21; its own currency statement is quoted in registers/source-bundle.json. The DBS yuu Card terms are 'Updated on 7 August 2026'; the PAssion terms 'Updated as of 29 Apr 2026' (promotion valid 1 October 2025 to 31 December 2026); the UOB Preferred Visa terms Ver 3.0 (10 Mar 2026); UOB Visa Signature Ver 2.1 (28 Oct 2025); UOB PRVI Miles Ver 3.4 (31 Jul 2026); the Trust Spend & Get terms Version 1 (21 September 2026). No rule-version axis: the encoding cannot answer about an earlier revision of any card's terms.
seat: the cardholder: the person who holds the cards and asks what a purchase earns
target_compiler: unstable (checked). main was not built or checked in this run.
scope: The reward-earning provisions only, of twelve card programmes: what a purchase earns, under which cap, against which pot, subject to which conditions, as a floor and a ceiling with the conditions named. Not the credit facility, not fees, not redemption beyond the conversion ratio each document states. Miles are given only where a held document converts the unit. It does not choose a card or allocate a month's spend across caps.
not_reviewed: No human has reviewed this encoding. It was written and checked by one model agent in one session. Every choice marked 'assumed, not ruled' in NOTES.md is open.
